title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: more indicator variants and larger detection groups
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, limits and controls are supported, and it correctly reports the conflicting limits documentation. Two minor corrections would make the policy-selection path more complete and flag Microsoft's differing role-management navigation labels.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A variant inherits a built-in indicator's properties and can tailor its detection using detection groups.
claims.quote: A variant inherits all the properties of the built-in indicator. You can modify the variant with exclusions or inclusions.

claims.claim: Detection groups support domains, file paths, file types, keywords, sensitive info types, SharePoint sites and trainable classifiers.
claims.quote:
Insider Risk Management currently supports seven detection types:
- Domains
- File paths
- File types
- Keywords
- Sensitive info types
- SharePoint sites
- Trainable classifiers

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Ignore activity involving items in selected groups excludes that activity from the variant's detections.
claims.quote: **Ignore activity involving items in selected groups**. Select this option if you want to capture everything except for a few *exclusions*.

claims.claim: A variant can detect only activity involving the items in selected groups.
claims.quote: **Only detect activity involving items in selected groups**. Select this option if you want to specify *inclusions* to capture.

claims.claim: Detection groups can also be selected for global exclusions, which exclude items from scoring across policies.
claims.quote: You can exclude items from being scored by Insider Risk Management policies by using the Global exclusions setting. These types of exclusions apply to every trigger and indicator for all policies that you create within a tenant.

claims.claim: No source says existing behaviour changes merely because the limits rise.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management indicator variants detection groups higher limits automatically default enable 10 500. Read roadmap, policy indicators, detection groups, limits and settings; no automatic change to existing detections is described.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; front matter: cost
claims.claim: No licence or separate charge specific to the higher variant and detection group limits is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management indicator variants detection groups limits licensing additional charge pay as you go variants billing. Read policy indicators, detection groups, Plan, Get started, Purview service description and billing models; no higher-limits-specific licence or charge is stated.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Some Insider Risk Management indicators require Purview pay-as-you-go billing.
claims.quote: Some indicators included in Insider Risk Management are only available if you enable the pay-as-you-go billing model for your organization.

claims.claim: Whether creating a variant of a pay-as-you-go indicator adds to its billing is not separately published.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management indicator variants detection groups limits licensing additional charge pay as you go variants billing. Read policy indicators, Get started and Purview billing models; billing covers processed user activities but does not state incremental billing for variants.

claims.claim: The roadmap item names no licence.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management variant limit is being increased from 3 to 10 per indicator and an overall limit of 100 across all indicators. Along with this, the number of items in one detection group is being increased from 200 to 500.

claims.claim: One variant can include up to five detection groups of a single type.
claims.quote: For a single variant, you can add up to five detection groups of a single type. For example, you can add up to five groups of domains, five groups of file types, and so on.

claims.claim: Some built-in indicators, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint indicators, do not support variants.
claims.quote: Some built-in indicators (Microsoft Defender for Endpoint indicators, for example) don't support variants.

claims.claim: Variants are configured in tenant-wide Insider Risk Management settings.
claims.quote: Insider Risk Management settings apply to all Insider Risk Management policies, regardless of the template you choose when creating a policy.

claims.claim: Detection groups are tenant-wide settings that can affect multiple policies.
claims.quote: Insider risk settings apply to all Insider Risk Management policies, regardless of the template you choose when creating a policy. These settings control privacy, indicators, global exclusions, detection groups, intelligent detections, and more.

claims.claim: Variants are selected for individual policies using the built-in indicator's variant list on the policy's Indicators page.
claims.quote: Go to the Indicators page of the policy workflow. Find the built-in indicator that includes one or more variants. Open the list to see the variants. If you select one or more checkboxes in the variant list, the first-level checkbox for the built-in indicator becomes a solid blue checkbox.
